subject: Fire Plate
text: Fire Plates rarely drop Might Armor, which is the best armor Aguro and the Hero can equip.

evidence.quote: These guys drop, rarely, but they do drop Might Armor, which is the best armor Aguro and Hero can ever have.

subject: Steel Lord
text: Steel Lords randomly drop the Grand Blade.

evidence.quote: In addition to that, the Steel Lords randomly drop a Grand Blade, a better sword.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Sour Cider can be found right in front of the entrance inside Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Inside the tower, take the Sour Cider in front of you.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: 750 Gold is located in the left room on the ground floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Items: Sour Cider, 750 Gold, Hi Potion, Power Gourd, Speed Potion, Hi Bomb, Revive, Big Arrow, Ex Potion, Swing Wing, Smoke Ball, Silver Tarot, Pirate Key, Heavy Ring...Go into the left room, take the gold, and then continue on.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Hi Potion is located through the door on the first floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Take the Hi Potion and proceed through the door in front of you.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Power Gourd is found through the left door on the second floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: On the second floor, head through the left door, take the Power Gourd, and go up to the third floor.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Speed Potion can be found in the room next to Raile on the third floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Speed Potion and Hi Bomb in the rooms next to him.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Hi Bomb is found in the room next to Raile on the third floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Take the Speed Potion and Hi Bomb in the rooms next to him.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Revive is located below Raile's location in Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Below is another Revive.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Big Arrow is found in a small side room along the right hallway.

evidence.quote: Take the Big Arrow and Ex Potion in the small rooms on the side of this new hallway.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: An Ex Potion is located in a small side room off the right hallway.

evidence.quote: Take the Big Arrow and Ex Potion in the small rooms on the side of this new hallway.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Swing Wing can be obtained on the fourth floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: In the center, head up to the next floor. Go up to get a Swing Wing and a Smoke Ball.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: A Smoke Ball is found on the fourth floor of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Go up to get a Swing Wing and a Smoke Ball.

subject: Aisen Tower switch puzzle
text: The switch puzzle on the fifth floor of Aisen Tower is solved by hitting switches in the order: Upper Left, Lower Right, Lower Left, Upper Right, followed by the top switch.

evidence.quote: On the fifth floor is the switch puzzle...It's 1) Upper Left, 2) Lower Right, 3) Lower Left, 4) Upper Right. Then hit the top switch, and the doors should open.

subject: Bosun
text: Bosun is horribly weak against physical attacks, allowing Hero, Lufia, and Aguro to deal combined turns of over 500 damage.

evidence.quote: I took out the Bosun in the first three rounds, dealing a combined 500-some damage to him each turn from Hero, Lufia, and Aguro, since he's horribly weak against physical attacks.

subject: Pirates
text: The Pirates boss enemy is very weak against magic such as Lufia's Blast spell.

evidence.quote: The Pirates is (or are, if you think about it, but it only looks like a single guy) very weak versus magic, and while he has some strong items like Ex Bombs and can cast a sleeping spell once every two blue moons, he's not much to worry about either...Just have Lufia use Blast and Jerin occasionally heal, and you'll have these guys done in no time.

subject: Lou
text: Lou joins you after defeating the pirates at the top of Aisen Tower.

evidence.quote: Lou, Raile's son, is up there, and he joins you.

subject: Aisen Tower
text: The Heavy Ring increases attack by 40 but significantly reduces speed.

evidence.quote: Take the two items and then go back and free Raile, don't talk to him yet, and take the Heavy Ring. It's your choice whether you want to equip this. It ups your attack by 40, except it makes you sinfully slow.

subject: Falcon
text: After gathering seven Alumina and rescuing Raile, Raile and Cooper finish work on the Falcon in Shaia Lab 3.

evidence.quote: Now that you have the seven pieces of Alumina as well as Raile properly secured, you can get the Falcon, and go to Doom Island, right?...warp back to Shaia Lab 3, heal in the basement, and then watch Raile and Cooper tinker around with the Falcon. It's done!

subject: Soshette
text: Soshette's armory sells Catwhips, Carbo Shields, Carbo Helms, and Carbo Caps.

evidence.quote: Soshette is a small island on the north tip of Ring Island. They have a pretty good armory, though. For weapons, hook the girls up with Catwhips. Buy a Carbo Shield for Hero, a Carbo Shield and Carbo Helm for Aguro, and two Carbo Caps for the girls.

subject: Magura
text: Magura enemies in the Underwater Cave have roughly 270 HP and deal about 100 damage per attack.

evidence.quote: I really hate the Magura monsters in here. They have about 270 HP, and they deal around 100 damage every time they attack.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: An Empty Bottle is found down the waterway in the top cave of the Underwater Cave.

evidence.quote: Go around and start at the top cave. Go down the nifty waterway, and take the Empty Bottle before jumping in the portal.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Miracle is located at the end of the long waterway to the right in the Underwater Cave.

evidence.quote: On the right, go along the super-long waterway and take the Miracle at the end.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Hi Potion is located at the end of the long waterway before entering the portal.

evidence.quote: Head down, and take the long waterway that rides you to the end. Don't jump in the portal, but go back and get the Hi Potion.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Magic Guard can be collected by taking the waterway adjacent to the Hi Potion and heading down.

evidence.quote: Take the waterway directly next to that, and then head down and collect the Magic Guard.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: An Opal is accessible by taking the downward path toward the right portal.

evidence.quote: Now, head back to the portal that was on your right. Don't go along the waterway from the beginning, head down and get to it from the downwards way, allowing you access to the Opal on your way.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A side-room in the Underwater Cave hallway contains a Miracle and a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: In this next hallway, don't be tempted to use the waterway, because you'll miss out on the Miracle and Hi Potion in the side-room.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Hi Potion is located alongside a Miracle in a hallway side-room in the Underwater Cave.

evidence.quote: In this next hallway, don't be tempted to use the waterway, because you'll miss out on the Miracle and Hi Potion in the side-room.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Hi Magic is found by heading right and up in the bottom right cave passage.

evidence.quote: You'll now be in the bottom right cave passage...Head right, up, and take the Hi Magic.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Foul Water and a Gloom Arrow are located on the south side of the center rock structure.

evidence.quote: Take the waterway to the left, and you'll come out on the south side of the center rock structure. Keep right a bit, and you'll get a Foul Water and a Gloom Arrow.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Gloom Arrow is found to the right on the south side of the center rock structure.

evidence.quote: Keep right a bit, and you'll get a Foul Water and a Gloom Arrow.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: The Zircon Wrist, armor exclusive to Jerin, is found by heading all the way left without taking the waterway.

evidence.quote: Now, go back to where you came in, and head all the way left you can, not taking the waterway, and recieve the Zircon Wrist, armor exclusively for Jerin.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: 800 Gold is found on the left side of the top waterway before jumping into the portal.

evidence.quote: Before jumping in the portal, head up, on the left side of the top waterway, to get 800 Gold.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Potion is located down inside the left passage of the Underwater Cave.

evidence.quote: Enter it, and go down to get a Potion.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Mystery Pin is found by heading down and left in the left passage of the Underwater Cave.

evidence.quote: Head down and left to get a Mystery Pin.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: An Ex Potion is found along the waterway after going right from the Mystery Pin.

evidence.quote: Go right, and then up and down the waterway to get an Ex and Spell Potion.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Spell Potion is located alongside an Ex Potion along the waterway in the left passage.

evidence.quote: Go right, and then up and down the waterway to get an Ex and Spell Potion.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: Arrows are obtained by heading right from the two downward waterways.

evidence.quote: Hop on the lower waterway, and then continue down and go back to where you see two downwards waterways going left and right. Head right and take the Arrows.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Power Potion is found past the Arrows where the waterway leads to a dead end.

evidence.quote: Keep going (the waterway only leads to a dead end) to reach a Power Potion.

subject: Underwater Cave
text: A Hi Potion is found down the left hallway using the waterway.

evidence.quote: Down the left hallway, using the waterway, you'll find a Hi Potion.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: The Dual Blade lies in the throne room on the second floor of the Fortress of Doom where the ancient Sinistral battle occurred.

evidence.quote: Head up to the second floor, then go around the balcony and head straight down and up to the throne room. The Dual Blade is lying right where the ancient battle with the Sinistrals took place.

subject: Epro
text: The armor shop in Epro sells Sword Shoes and Cat Heels.

evidence.quote: They have good shoes, so pick up two Sword Shoes and Cat Heels.

subject: Hedge
text: Hedge gives you the Oil Key when spoken to in the valley northwest of Epro.

evidence.quote: Hedge is north, but you have to go northwest to get to him, and then head right into a little valley and speak to him. He'll hand you the Oil Key.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: An Ex Bomb and an Ex Potion are found inside a cave all the way across the waterways to the left.

evidence.quote: Head all the way left, across the waterways, and enter the cave for Ex Bomb and Ex Potion.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: An Ex Potion is located in the left cave across the waterways in the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head all the way left, across the waterways, and enter the cave for Ex Bomb and Ex Potion.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Power Potion and a Big Arrow can be found by heading up the right path in the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head up the right part and get a Power Potion and Big Arrow.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Big Arrow is obtained alongside a Power Potion on the right path of the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head up the right part and get a Power Potion and Big Arrow.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Mystery Pin is found by going up the left side of the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head up the left side and take the Mystery Pin.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Miracle is located inside the north room of the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Go into the north room to get a Miracle.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Hi Magic is located down the waterway from the north room in the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head down, using the waterway, and then grab the Hi Magic and get out of there, and head back to the left passageway.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Power Gourd is obtained across the left waterway in the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Go across the left waterway, take the Power Gourd.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: A Magic Guard can be obtained in the Underwater Tunnel by walking all the way back around.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, you have to go all the way back and around to get the Magic Guard.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: The Grand Sword is located by heading up right before the portal exit in the Underwater Tunnel.

evidence.quote: Head up, take the ever-useless Grand Sword, and then jump in the portal.

subject: Epro Cave
text: 850 Gold is found right inside after unlocking the cave entrance door with the Oil Key.

evidence.quote: Unlock the door with the Oil Key, and then proceed in, taking the 850 Gold.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Dragon Arrow is found in the room following the 850 Gold chest in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Unlock the door with the Oil Key, and then proceed in, taking the 850 Gold. Take the Dragon Arrow in the next room, and then loop around and through the muck to get the Hi Bomb.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Hi Bomb is found by looping through the muck in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Take the Dragon Arrow in the next room, and then loop around and through the muck to get the Hi Bomb.

subject: Rock Golem
text: Rock Golems frequently use Stone Arm to petrify characters, and only Hero and Aguro deal sufficient damage against them.

evidence.quote: What really pisses me off is the abundance of Rock Golems in here, who with their skill 'Stone Arm' (which they use quite often) can automatically turn your characters to stone. And, did I mention that only Hero and Aguro can do sufficient damage to them?

subject: Mad Knight
text: Mad Knights have over 400 HP and cast Boost on one another.

evidence.quote: The Mad Knights also make me, well, mad. They have well over 400 HP, yet they all use boost on each other.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Dragon Tooth is located down the first ladder in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Head down the ladder, take the Dragon Tooth, then head down the next ladder, and go all the way right.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Big Arrow is found all the way to the right down the second ladder in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: then head down the next ladder, and go all the way right. Take the Big Arrow, and then head up the ladder to get a Miracle.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Miracle is found up the ladder near the Big Arrow in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Take the Big Arrow, and then head up the ladder to get a Miracle.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Hi Magic is hidden in the muck down the far right ladder, specifically in the second row of muck from the right, two steps down.

evidence.quote: Down the last right ladder, there is a Hi Magic hidden in the second row of muck from the right, two steps down.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Dragon Ring is found near the hidden Hi Magic in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Take the Dragon Ring, and then go down the ladder on the other side to get to the second floor.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A second Dragon Tooth is located to the north after descending to the second floor of Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Go forward, and down the ladder. North is a Dragon Tooth.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Hi Potion is found by continuing under the bridge and heading up in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Continue under the bridge, and go up for a Hi Potion.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Swing Wing is located straight down below the bridge in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Head straight down, and below is a Swing Wing.

subject: Epro Cave
text: An Ex Bomb is found by crossing the bridge from the starting path in Epro Cave and continuing right.

evidence.quote: Go along the path, go across the bridge, and continue right to get an Ex Bomb.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Hi Magic is obtained down past the bridge before descending the stairs.

evidence.quote: Go down, take the Hi Magic, and then head down the stairs.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Miracle is located straight down the ladder and around on the second floor of Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: On the second floor, head straight down the ladder, and around you'll get a Miracle.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A third Dragon Tooth is found down a ladder on the right side of the second floor.

evidence.quote: Head right and then go around and down the ladder to get a third Dragon Tooth.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A third Hi Magic is found by heading down the right ladder and going right in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Now head down the right ladder, and go right to get a third Hi Magic.

subject: Epro Cave
text: A Great Potion is found down the north ladder right before encountering the Oil Dragon in Epro Cave.

evidence.quote: Go down the north ladder, take the Great Potion, heal your characters' HP and MP, and then 'inspect' the dragon.

subject: Oil Dragon
text: Lufia's Sunder spell deals massive damage to the Oil Dragon, while Jerin should cast Glacier and Boost.

evidence.quote: Have Hero and Aguro attack as usual, have Lufia use her newfound 'Sunder' spell, which takes a big chunk off of the dragon's HP, and have Jerin use Glacier, occasionally using Boost to heal.

subject: Oil Dragon
text: At low HP, the Oil Dragon uses Dash for 120-140 damage on a single target, an upgraded Fire Air dealing 90-140 damage to all, and casts Magic Mirror.

evidence.quote: When you start to be dwindling down his HP, he'll use Dash, which takes down about 120-140 from a single character, and an upgraded Fire Air, which does around 90-140 damage to everyone. He also has a nasty habit of using Magic Mirror, especially right after you cast Sunder on him ~_~.

subject: Oil Dragon
text: After defeating the Oil Dragon, you obtain the Power Oil.

evidence.quote: After the battle, you can take the Power Oil and escape.
